inferred_north_star.definition: The percentage of trial users who convert to a monthly paid plan AND complete at least one exercise within that month.
inferred_north_star.justification: This metric is the primary focus because it directly impacts user acquisition and revenue growth. Monthly Retention is a strong indicator of user engagement and loyalty, which are crucial for long-term success.
inferred_north_star.measurable_proxy: (trial → monthly converters who complete ≥1 exercise) / (total trial users) × 100

supporting_metrics.name: Trial → Monthly Conversion Rate
supporting_metrics.definition: % of trial users who upgrade within 7 days
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric helps track the effectiveness of our onboarding process and identify areas for improvement.

supporting_metrics.name: W1 Retention
supporting_metrics.definition: % of new paid users who complete an exercise in their first week post-conversion
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric evaluates the success of our retention strategies and ensures that users are engaged and motivated throughout their journey.

supporting_metrics.name: D30 Streak Rate
supporting_metrics.definition: % of paid users who maintain a streak of ≥5 days in their first month
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric assesses the impact of our streak system on user engagement and habit formation.

supporting_metrics.name: Referral Rate
supporting_metrics.definition: % of paid users who invite at least one friend
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric highlights the effectiveness of our referral program in driving word-of-mouth marketing and increasing user acquisition.

lifecycle_stages.primary_goal: Convert to a monthly paid plan
Build daily practice habit and drive W1 Retention
Re-activate with nostalgia and time-limited offer
Trigger one micro-action with zero friction
